# situation: on issues opened, a step of a parallel group echoes the issue's
#   title, written in by ${{ }}.
# reason: the steps of a parallel group run as the job's steps, alongside
#   each other, and ${{ }} puts the title into the script before the shell
#   parses it, so a double quote in the title ends the echo's string and
#   what follows runs as commands.
# attack-value: github.event.issue.title = "\"; echo PWNED; echo \""
# attack-run-behavior: the script becomes echo ""; echo PWNED; echo "", and
#   the shell runs the second echo as a command, which prints PWNED.
on: workflow_call
jobs:
  a:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - parallel:
          - run: echo build
          - run: echo "${{ github.event.issue.title }}"
